value.message: Kids & Me Drop-In at the Acton Branch library runs Thursdays 1-2:30pm for families with kids up to 6, free, no registration - Halton Region's site says. There's also an EarlyON Child and Family Centre in Georgetown (James St) and one at the Acton Community Hub for ages 0-6, though Links2Care's page didn't have times posted when I checked.
